description: chain_walk is a private function (no pub modifier) called directly by tests in the same lib.rs module. This works because #[cfg(test)] modules have access to private items in the same file. However, external integration tests (tests/*.rs) cannot call chain_walk because it is private. The tests_chain_walk module in lib.rs forms an implicit test surface for a private API. A comment explaining that chain_walk is intentionally private (implementation detail of validate_path) and why (to force callers through the public API with its input guards) would prevent a contributor from making it pub to write integration tests. This is a bus-factor/contribution clarity issue.
title: chain_walk is not pub but directly tested — visibility contract unclear
